untrustedWorkspaces.description: GAEP shows a trust stop line but does not inspect agent executables, mutate Product state, recover runs, or start processes until the workspace is trusted.

chatParticipants.name: gaep
chatParticipants.description: Governed, multi-turn Product and engineering lifecycle workflows.

commands.name: initialize
commands.description: Start a challenged, review-before-commit Product initialization

commands.name: revise
commands.description: Revise existing Product fields with AI challenge and an audited commit

commands.name: continue
commands.description: Inspect governed state and start or resume the next valid workflow

commands.name: advisor
commands.description: Select or change the Codex/Claude Code Product advisor and model

commands.name: agent
commands.description: Switch between Codex and Claude Code, then select its model

commands.name: model
commands.description: Switch models within the current Product Chat agent

commands.name: accept
commands.description: Explicitly accept the current AI-assisted proposal and continue

commands.name: status
commands.description: Show governed Product and conversational draft status

commands.name: review
commands.description: Review the exact completed initialization draft

commands.name: back
commands.description: Return to and replace the previous answer

commands.name: commit
commands.description: Explicitly commit a reviewed Product draft

commands.name: help
commands.description: Show GAEP interactive Product workspace commands

gaep.codex.executable.description: Machine-scoped Codex executable name or absolute path. Workspace overrides are ignored, and GAEP never reads Codex credentials.

gaep.claude.executable.description: Machine-scoped Claude Code executable name or absolute path. Workspace overrides are ignored, and GAEP never reads Claude credentials.

scripts.package: npm run build && vsce package --no-dependencies --allow-missing-repository -o dist/gaep-vscode.vsix
scripts.verify: npm run typecheck && npm run build && npm run test:dom && npm run test:extension-host
